description: Audit the evidence behind a paper's retraction picture: every source record with its tier and URI, the dates involved, conflicts between sources (an official registry and an aggregator disagreeing, or a citation acknowledging a retraction the graph does not propagate) and the coverage gaps that bound the conclusion. Use it when you must justify or challenge a verdict; for a one-line status use integrity_paper_status. Returns: evidence records with source tiers and URIs, detected conflict flags with codes and details, and the coverage that limits how strong the conclusion can be. Paid: $0.10 per call (x402 on Base, POST /api/v1/judge); a keyed MCP session also unlocks it.

doi.description: DOI of the paper, e.g. 10.1016/S0140-6736(97)11096-0. Provide exactly one of doi or paper_id.

paper_id.description: OpenAlex work id, e.g. W2117847125. Provide exactly one of doi or paper_id.

name: integrity_evidence_audit
